description: Welcome to Exploit_Syndicate, a Cybersecurity team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Combining our cybersecurity foundation with Web Development and AI/ML concepts, we aim to build an intelligent, secure, and impactful web solution for space and data challenges.
summary: AstroShield is a cyber-secure astronaut health monitoring web application developed by Team Ghost Jackal_0x for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Long-duration space missions expose crew members to space radiation, microgravity bone loss, cardiovascular strain, and isolation stress without onboard physicians. At the same time, medical telemetry transmitted between spacecraft and Mission Control is vulnerable to cyber interception and Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) data spoofing attacks. AstroShield solves both challenges by tracking real-time crew biometrics—including Heart Rate (ECG), Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Cumulative Space Radiation, Bone Density Index, and Behavioral Stress—while providing an Autonomous Action Advisor that recommends immediate medical and survival protocols. Furthermore, it integrates a Security Operations Center (SOC) defense layer using TLS 1.3, AES-256-GCM encryption, SHA-256 packet verification, and an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) to detect, quarantine, and block spoofed medical data before it can endanger astronaut safety.
details:
What It Does & How It Works
AstroShield is an interactive NASA Mission Control and Cybersecurity SOC web application designed to help astronauts monitor their health and protect critical medical telemetry during deep-space missions.
  • Real-Time Biometric & Radiation Dashboard: Monitors Heart Rate (ECG waveform), Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Cumulative Space Radiation (mSv/day), Bone Density & Muscle Load Index, and Behavioral Stress/Sleep metrics.
  • Autonomous Astronaut Action Advisor: Evaluates changes in vital signs and provides immediate, actionable health and survival steps (such as entering radiation storm shelters during solar particle events or performing resistive exercise).
  • Interactive Scenario Simulator: Includes four live modes—Nominal Orbit, Solar Particle Storm, Cyber Attack (MitM Data Spoofing), and Engage AI-IDS & Key Rotation—allowing crew and judges to test medical and security responses in real time.
  • Cyber-Defense & SOC Terminal: Protects bio-telemetry streams with simulated TLS 1.3 + AES-256-GCM encryption and SHA-256 hash verification. When a spoofing attack injects fake critical vitals, AstroShield flags the tampered packets, quarantines the corrupted stream, warns the crew not to administer medication based on false telemetry, blocks the rogue IP, rotates keys, and exports a SHA-256 signed Mission Audit Report.
Benefits & Intended Impact
AstroShield empowers astronauts to self-diagnose and act on physiological changes during long-duration missions (Lunar Gateway, Mars) while ensuring mission-critical health data cannot be manipulated by cyber threats.
Tools & Technologies Used
  • Frontend & UI: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5/CSS3, and interactive SVG/Canvas telemetry charts.
  • Super Intelligence (SI) Disclosure: We utilized v0 by Vercel (AI-assisted UI/frontend code generation) and LLM assistance to accelerate frontend prototyping, layout design, and telemetry simulation logic based on our team's cybersecurity and space-health architecture.
